controls.title: Insecure cloud, container or orchestration configuration
controls.text: Cloud resources should be provisioned with secure-by-default configuration rather than relying on a platform's permissive defaults, since a single misconfigured resource can expose an entire environment.

controls.title: CI/CD pipeline and software supply chain flaws
controls.text: Third-party Terraform modules and container images referenced by IaC should be pinned to a specific, verified version rather than trusting a mutable reference like a branch or 'latest' tag.

controls.title: Insecure secrets storage
controls.text: Credentials, API keys, and other secrets must never be stored in plaintext in source code, configuration files, or version control history.

controls.title: Over-permissive or insecure network policies
controls.text: Network access controls (security groups, NACLs, firewall rules) should default to deny and only permit the specific traffic a workload requires.
